name: 3,000 L tank (carport)
notes: On the south-east corner of the carport, filled from the carport and the south-east part of the house roof. Plastic, about 30 years old, on a pump about 20 years old: both are near the end of their life, so plan to replace them in the next few years. A second 2,000 L tank (about 20 years old) is not in use; its spot is still to be marked.
